material.acceptance_criteria: A pointercancel clears press and box, and the overlay is hidden. onDown clears any leftover box before a new press. After a touch drag that the browser cancels, no selection rectangle remains on screen.
material.description: moba_input.js registers only pointerdown, pointermove and pointerup (moba_input.js:57-59). No pointercancel handler exists under js/client, and no touch-action rule is set. When the browser takes a touch as a pan, it fires pointercancel and no pointerup, so onUp (moba_input.js:50-54) never clears press or box. onDown (moba_input.js:38-42) does not clear box either, and onMove (moba_input.js:44-48) keeps updating box from pointer moves that carry no button. Symptom: after a one-finger drag on the map, a green selection rectangle stays on screen and follows the pointer until the next pointerup. This affects phone layouts, which the project targets.
material.subject: A cancelled press leaves the drag box on screen until the next tap
material.witness: Live page (verify-illegal-trav-input-client-2): after pointerdown and an 80px drag, pointercancel now sets overlay display none (drag:block | cancel:none | moveNoButton:none | repress:none); before the fix the overlay stayed block at 80px then 150px.
